description: Header file defining data structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling TrueType GX font variation tables in the FreeType project.

methods.name: TT_Set_MM_Blend
methods.description: Sets the font's multiple master blend coordinates.

methods.name: TT_Set_Var_Design
methods.description: Sets the variation design coordinates for a font.

methods.name: TT_Get_MM_Var
methods.description: Retrieves the multiple master variation data for a font.

methods.name: tt_face_vary_cvt
methods.description: Converts variation data for a face from a stream.

methods.name: TT_Vary_Apply_Glyph_Deltas
methods.description: Applies glyph deltas for variation adjustments.

methods.name: tt_done_blend
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with a GX_Blend.
